meta.name: convert-documents-to-markdown
meta.description: Convert an attached Word document, presentation, spreadsheet, OpenDocument file, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF into local Markdown. Use when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把办公文档转成Markdown格式
copy.tagline_en: Turn office documents into local Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need office documents as Markdown

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用容器内的 AnyDoc 命令把消息里附带的 Word、表格、PDF 等文档转成本地 Markdown 文件,并告诉你输出路径。转换在本地完成,不上传外部服务。
howto.when: 当消息里给出本地附件路径、需要在不把它上传到外部解析器的情况下读取时触发,覆盖 Word、表格、PDF 等格式。

say.text: 把附件里的 CSV 转成 Markdown 读给我
say.note: CSV 走标准输入并按 --format csv 转换

say.text: 只用本地路径转这个文档,不要上传到外部解析器
say.note: 失败时只报告原因,不做外部上传

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses the container's AnyDoc CLI to convert an attached Word file, spreadsheet, PDF and similar documents into local Markdown, then tells you the output path. Conversion stays inside the agent container.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser; covers Word, spreadsheets, PDFs and similar formats.

say_en.note: Runs anydoc in the container and prints the output path

say_en.text: Turn the attached CSV into Markdown and show me
Convert this document from its local path only, no upload
say_en.note: On failure it reports the reason, no external upload
